query: How deep sea creatures survive the pressure?
title: How deep sea creatures survive the pressure?
description:
Most deep-sea animals are largely water and avoid large gas-filled spaces, so pressure does not crush them like an air-filled body. Their cells and metabolism are also adapted to function at the pressures where they live.
